svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: What arrives without being asked
svg.desc: Five moments at which codefast adds facts to a session through hooks. When a prompt names a symbol: its definition, whole when it is short, and how widely it is used. When a prompt quotes an error message or a log line: the line of code that writes it, the function around that line and who calls it. After the agent searches for a symbol: what the search did not print, such as who calls it. After the agent edits a file: the places that still use a name the edit removed. After the context is compacted: which definitions the uncommitted changes added, removed and altered.
svg.text: Five moments of a session. A hook with nothing new to say prints nothing.
the code itself, and who uses it
